step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows mobile/web users interacting with an API Gateway which triggers AWS Lambda functions. Lambda interacts with MongoDB. Game APIs also stream score data to Lambda, which saves match data directly to S3. MongoDB data is also exported to S3. Amazon S3 feeds into Amazon EMR for leaderboard calculations and Amazon Redshift for business analytics.

edges.notes: User sends requests to API Gateway.
API Gateway routes request to Lambda.
Lambda persists match updates into S3.
MongoDB data gets backed up to S3.
EMR processes match data from S3.
S3 transfers data to Redshift for analytics.
